task-waitasync-timeout.title: Add a timeout to Task waiting with WaitAsync
task-waitasync-timeout.short: Bound waiting time without changing the original Task
task-waitasync-timeout.summary: WaitAsync combines waiting for an existing Task with a timeout or CancellationToken.
task-waitasync-timeout.why: A caller can stop waiting indefinitely even when the underlying API cannot be changed.
task-waitasync-timeout.tips: Stopping the wait does not necessarily stop the underlying operation; pass cancellation into that operation when possible.

periodictimer-loop.title: Write asynchronous periodic loops with PeriodicTimer
periodictimer-loop.summary: PeriodicTimer exposes recurring ticks through WaitForNextTickAsync.
periodictimer-loop.why: Periodic work can be written as a normal async loop rather than overlapping callbacks.
periodictimer-loop.tips: Account for work duration relative to the period and use cancellation and disposal for shutdown.

frozenset-lookup.title: Optimize read-only set lookup with FrozenSet
frozenset-lookup.short: Freeze stable data for repeated membership tests
frozenset-lookup.summary: FrozenSet<T> is an immutable set representation optimized for lookup after construction.
frozenset-lookup.why: It suits data initialized once and queried with Contains many times.
frozenset-lookup.tips: Construction has a cost, so benchmark against HashSet for small or frequently rebuilt sets.

conditionalweaktable-metadata.title: Attach metadata without extending object lifetime using ConditionalWeakTable
conditionalweaktable-metadata.short: Associate external data while allowing keys to be collected
conditionalweaktable-metadata.summary: ConditionalWeakTable associates values with reference-type keys without keeping a key alive solely because it is in the table.
conditionalweaktable-metadata.why: Infrastructure can attach caches or metadata to objects it cannot modify.
conditionalweaktable-metadata.tips: It is not a general Dictionary replacement; use it only when weak lifetime semantics matter.

memorypool-rent.title: Rent owned buffers with MemoryPool<T>
memorypool-rent.short: Acquire reusable storage exposed as Memory<T>
memorypool-rent.summary: MemoryPool<T> returns IMemoryOwner<T>, making ownership and return of rented Memory<T> explicit.
memorypool-rent.why: Buffers that cross async boundaries can combine Memory with a clear lifetime owner.
memorypool-rent.tips: Always dispose the owner and remember that the returned Memory may be larger than requested.

sequencereader-parse.title: Parse segmented buffers with SequenceReader<T>
sequencereader-parse.short: Advance through ReadOnlySequence without concatenating segments
sequencereader-parse.summary: SequenceReader<T> provides cursor-style parsing helpers over a segmented ReadOnlySequence<T>.
sequencereader-parse.why: Data from pipelines can be parsed without copying every segment into one array.
sequencereader-parse.tips: Check each API's advancement behavior on failure and treat incomplete input as a normal parsing case.

convert-tohexstring.title: Convert bytes to hexadecimal with Convert.ToHexString
convert-tohexstring.summary: ToHexString and FromHexString convert between bytes and hexadecimal text.
convert-tohexstring.why: Hashes and binary identifiers can be displayed or stored with concise standard APIs.
convert-tohexstring.tips: Hex text uses two characters per byte, so confirm it is appropriate for large payloads.

activitysource-tracing.title: Trace operation spans with ActivitySource
activitysource-tracing.short: Record operation relationships and tags for distributed tracing
activitysource-tracing.summary: ActivitySource starts Activity spans that carry parent relationships and diagnostic tags.
activitysource-tracing.why: Tracing can reveal where latency occurs across asynchronous work and service boundaries.
activitysource-tracing.tips: Avoid unbounded high-cardinality tags and design instrumentation with the telemetry backend in mind.

semaphore-slim-waitasync.title: Limit async concurrency with SemaphoreSlim.WaitAsync
semaphore-slim-waitasync.short: Gate scarce resources without synchronously blocking threads
semaphore-slim-waitasync.summary: WaitAsync asynchronously waits for a SemaphoreSlim permit.
semaphore-slim-waitasync.why: It can bound concurrent network calls or expensive operations and reduce resource exhaustion.
semaphore-slim-waitasync.tips: Release in finally after every successful acquisition and avoid double releases.

file-readlines-lazy.title: Read large text files lazily with File.ReadLines
file-readlines-lazy.short: Process lines without loading the whole file
file-readlines-lazy.summary: File.ReadLines enumerates file lines as they are needed.
file-readlines-lazy.why: Large text files can be processed incrementally instead of allocating an array containing every line.
file-readlines-lazy.tips: The file remains part of the enumeration lifetime; retain only values you need after enumeration.
